candidates.title: Specify stable CLI exit outcomes
candidates.fact: The own CLI's inspected suite checks diagnostics text. The reference suite asserts separate exit codes for clean input, findings, and input errors.
candidates.inference: An equivalent behavioral test could stabilize the integration boundary without duplicating the formatter split.
candidates.recommendation: Borrow the acceptance cases only; implement them independently in the existing test stack. Do not copy source.
candidates.benefit: Automation can distinguish findings from an invocation or input failure.
candidates.license: No source reuse proposed. Reference license or distribution permission not assessed.
candidates.stackFit: The acceptance cases are process-level and can be expressed with the existing TypeScript test runner.
candidates.maintenanceCost: Three process-level fixtures and stable expected codes; no new runtime dependency.
candidates.architectureImpact: Keep parsing, checking, and text output intact. Change only the observed CLI outcome contract if required.

tasks.title: Add exit-code acceptance tests
dependencies: Confirm the public exit-code mapping before changes.
steps: Add own test inputs for clean input, violations, and an unreadable file.
Assert the process result without depending on text formatting.
tasks.acceptance: Clean input exits 0; Markdown findings exit 1; unreadable input exits 2. Existing text diagnostics remain unchanged.
tasks.rollback: Revert the new assertions and any exit-code changes; no state or migration to roll back.
